Tailscale Funnel strips the path prefix when using --set-path, so when Funnel is configured with '--set-path /hooks/github 8077', the relay backend receives 'POST /' instead of 'POST /hooks/github', causing a 404.

**The fix:** In module.nix, change the Funnel ExecStart to mount at '/' so the full request path passes through to the relay. The relay already handles its own routing with 'POST /hooks/github' in cmd/relay/main.go.

Current (broken):
```
ExecStart = tailscale funnel --bg --yes --set-path /hooks/github ${toString cfg.port}
```

Fix:
```
ExecStart = tailscale funnel --bg --yes ${toString cfg.port}
```

Also update ExecStop — currently it uses 'tailscale funnel --yes reset' which would nuke ALL funnel config. It should only remove its own entry. Check if 'tailscale funnel off' or 'tailscale funnel ${port} off' is more appropriate.

**Files to change:**
- module.nix — the systemd service ExecStart/ExecStop for github-relay-funnel

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Funnel mounts at / so the relay receives the full path (POST /hooks/github)
- ExecStop only removes the relay's funnel entry, not all funnel config
- The module still works as a NixOS module (test with 'nix flake check' if possible)
